craft_notes: Sthāyin: even-knowing calms (jñānam api — EVEN known-ness becomes calm: the api-totalizer). Rows: row 2 (voidness→calm). Close: calm (śāmyati — the block's thesis-verb). Rejected: 'everything is empty' — killed: in-things voidness kept (locatives matter: voidness IN things, not as doctrine); 'peace' — killed: calm kept (śama as verb-event, not noun-state).

lines: In inner things, in all things voidness:
her meditated even — known, becomes calm.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vastvantare vedyamāne sarvavastuṣu śūnyatā | tām eva manasā dhyātvā vidito 'pi praśāmyati

reads_against.argmap: What calms when voidness is meditated? → Meditating voidness in all things, even known-ness becomes calm.
c1_essence: Voidness meditated in all things: even knowing calms.
